pr_title: domain, util/replayer: increase GC duration for plan replayer capture file to 7 days
pr_body:

Issue Number: close #43663 


### What is changed and how it works?

- For plan replayer capture file without historical stats enabled, name it "capture_normal_replayer_XXX.zip".
- As title says, increase  GC duration for plan relayer capture file to 7 days

issue_context.title: plan replayer capture file's GC time is too short for the user
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Currently, the plan replayer zip file's GC time is 1 hour.

However, for plan replayer capture task, this is too short. The user will easily miss the captured result.

We need to increase it for a better user experience.
